reasons.claim: Notification is a 5.72 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Alvesta, status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

One eligible species, Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of continuity forest and of large/old trees), recorded 550 m from the polygon (2025, 25 m uncertainty): beyond 250 m, within 1000 m. No eligible species within 250 m.

Within 250 m, the red-listed records are Arnica montana (VU), Polygala vulgaris (NT), Leontodon hispidus (NT) and Boloria selene (VU). The tool flags none as eligible; Arnica and the two NT plants are marked not forest-associated.
Effort is adequate: 248 records, 88th percentile in county sample, above the county median of 54. Within 250 m there are 14 records on 4 days; nothing inside the polygon.
Several site-bound forest NT species (e.g. Crossocalyx hellerianus at 489 m) occur within 1000 m but not within 250 m, so the NT-count criterion is not met.

uncertainties: Records show species were recorded, not that they occupy the polygon today.
The nearest eligible record is 550 m away; its relation to the stand's habitat is unknown.
No records inside the polygon; the site may simply be unvisited.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the felling site itself.
Forest age or structure of the stand.
Anything about legality of the felling or biodiversity value.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for continuity-forest and old-tree features and consider a field check of Alectoria sarmentosa habitat near the 550 m record before felling starts.
